_comment: M2 controlled comparison, synthetic case NFH_BO (tests/bo_helpers.py), specialist M1S2 Customer Stickiness & Concentration. Written BEFORE the comparison was run; not tuned to its output. 'acceptable' lists the dispositions that count as the desired outcome. Model responses in both arms are scripted to be EQUALLY WRONG: the same claims, the same quotes, the same asserted statuses. The comparison therefore measures what each pipeline's deterministic controls catch, not model reasoning.

S1_control_payer_category_share.description: Correct reported fact: government programmes are 45% of revenue, i.e. concentration by payer category.

S2_genuine_quote_wrong_inference.description: Genuine quote (multi-year agreements set negotiated rates) used to claim guaranteed volumes; the same passage says volumes are not guaranteed.

S3_correct_number_irrelevant_claim.description: Correct, deterministically bound number (Texas 30% of revenue) attached to an unrelated claim (patient relationships are sticky); also conflates geographic exposure (owned by M2) with stickiness.

S4_absence_as_safety.description: Non-disclosure of an individual payer above 10% treated as evidence of low concentration.

S5_mitigant_without_outcome.description: Multi-year agreements claimed to demonstrably mitigate termination risk; no outcome evidence, and the passage says either party may terminate on notice.

S6_ignored_contradiction.description: Termination risk claimed low while the packet states either party may terminate on notice; the model cites only the supportive sentence.

S7_control_terminable_no_volume_commitme.description: Correct reported fact: agreements do not guarantee minimum volumes and can be terminated on notice.
